answer: To control pink bollworm in cotton, use the recommended insecticides or biological controls.
For boll rot in cotton, you can use Copper oxy chloride @1000 g/acre or Carbendazim @ 200 g /acre or Mancozeb @ 800 g / acre.
To control whitefly in paruthi, follow integrated pest management practices including cultural, biological, and chemical controls.
For a yield target of 4 t per hectare, apply NPK fertilisers as per soil test recommendations. If soil test is not done, use the blanket recommendation of 60:30:30 kg NPK/ha.
To control rhinoceros beetle in coconut, maintain good sanitation by removing and burning dead trees and affected leaves, and use traps and attractants to manage the pest population.
To manage red palm weevil in your coconut garden, remove and burn all wilting or damaged palms and avoid injuries on stems to prevent further perpetuation of the pest.

The planting season for coconut is June-July and December-January. The recommended spacing is 25' x 25' (7.5 x 7.5 m).
To control rhizome rot in turmeric, treat the seed rhizomes with copper oxychloride @ 0.3% for 30 minutes or drench with 1% Bordeaux mixture or copper oxychloride @ 0.25%.
For leaf blotch and leaf spot in turmeric, you can use Mancozeb 0.25% or copper oxy chloride 0.25%.
For turmeric in the base area, it is recommended to apply FYM as a basal application.
The recommended bed spacing for turmeric is 45 cm x 25 cm.
